summary: Magazzino phase 2 — Richieste/DDT flow tested end-to-end. Backend 25/25 passed. Frontend flows all pass after fixing 1 critical missing useState bug on ProdottiMagazzinoPage (setFormQuantity was undefined, broke the entire edit form).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing useState declaration for formQuantity/setFormQuantity. Caused ReferenceError: setFormQuantity is not defined at openEditForm, crashing the edit form completely. Fixed by testing agent.

action_items: Review the ProdottiMagazzinoPage fix (added const [formQuantity, setFormQuantity] = useState(0)). Main agent should verify the initial value logic matches intent.
Consider restoring a product quantity value that the frontend test updated during validation (one product was set to 99 to verify save flow; non-critical).
critical_code_review_comments: ProdottiMagazzinoPage.js had a missing useState hook for formQuantity despite referencing setFormQuantity in resetForm and openEditForm and formQuantity in save payload. Any change should include a smoke check that product edit opens without runtime errors.

server.py is ~1868 lines — approaching the 'should split' threshold (warehouse, richieste, products, orders, auth all in one file). Consider extracting richieste router and products router into separate modules.
LOCATION_ADDRESSES maps both 'Largo di Brazzà' and 'Brazza' to same address — defensive and good.
Global DDT counter uses atomic $inc with upsert — correct, handles concurrent restaurant requests properly.
_enrich_richiesta always sets mittente/destinatario and strips _id — consistent with frontend expectations.
evade endpoint correctly decrements stock atomically per item and rejects second evade (status != 'pending') — prevents double decrement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after bug fix (Flaminio create -> DDT redirect -> Magazziniere evade -> Flaminio conferma all verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: During testing: created 2 richieste from Flaminio (DDT#? deleted via conferma path) and Grazie (deleted in test cleanup). Stock of 1 product was modified during PATCH quantity test (reverted); edit-form test set one product quantity to 99.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Richieste/DDT endpoints and UI flows are working. The ProdottiMagazzinoPage.js had a missing useState hook for formQuantity/setFormQuantity that was fixed inline; main agent should confirm no other pages have similar missing hooks. DDT auto-increments globally (confirmed via back-to-back Flaminio+Grazie creates). real_quantity correctly subtracts pending items across all locations. Dialog-based confirmations use window.confirm — Playwright needs page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) before clicking btn-evadi / btn-conferma.

verified_flows.DDT_redirect_and_layout: PASS (Pastasciutta Srl, Piazzale Flaminio, DOCUMENTO DI TRASPORTO, btn-stampa-ddt present)
verified_flows.role_based_403s: PASS (magazziniere cannot create/conferma/delete; locale cannot evade/patch-quantity/see others' richieste)
